timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Let's take a look at how to submit an assignment in Google Classroom from the student perspective.
We're going to begin in my class and you can see here on my stream, I'm being told
I have a new assignment so I can access it from here or I can go into my classwork and
I can access the assignment here as well.
Let's click on the assignment and say view assignment.
Once I'm in the assignment I can see my due date, the assignment name and how many points
it's worth.
If I have questions about the assignment that I would like to talk to the rest of my class
about, I can add those comments here.
However, if I'd like to send a private comment to my instructor about this assignment, I
will want to do that on the right hand side under private comments here at the bottom.
Most of what I'm after here, however, is on the right hand side towards the top.
When it comes time for me to turn my assignment in, I can either add or create an assignment
on the fly and here you'll see I can access my Google Drive.
I can also use a link to something on the web or I can upload a file from my computer.
And here I can even create new documents in my Google Drive on the fly.
This assignment, however, I was given a worksheet so I'm going to start by clicking on this
document here under my work.
This is my prompt and I'm just going to go ahead and fill it in.
When I'm finished, all I need to do is close this window.
Once I'm back in my assignment, if I'm ready to turn it in, I'll click Turn it in.
Before I do that, however, you'll see that I have this originality report so as a student
I can run this and it's going to highlight anything that I might have plagiarized or
copied from another source from the web.
This has been an opportunity to change my document and remove any of the plagiarism or
cite it properly.
When I'm ready, I'll click Turn it in.
It makes sure that I know I'm turning it in and I click Turn it in one more time.
Now as long as I am within this date parameter, I can unsubmit my assignment.
So let's say I realized I did it incorrectly or I submitted the wrong assignment.
I can click Unsubmit and it gives me an opportunity to continue on editing my document
or adding something new.
Again, I will then have to return it in by clicking in Turn in.
Again, you can only do that if you are within the due date parameter.
After this date and time, you will no longer be able to click Unsubmit.
